data.name: Jawziyyah
data.gender_notes: Jawziyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jawziyyah is an Arabic name that means 'flower' or 'blossom'. It symbolizes beauty, innocence, and purity. In Islamic tradition, it is considered a noble and virtuous name. The name Jawziyyah carries the meaning “Flower, Blossom” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jawziyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody flower, blossom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, flowers and blossoms are often used as metaphors for spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Jawziyyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Flower, Blossom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawziyyah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: جوزية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من جوز، يعني الشخصية القوية والثابتة
in_arabic.long_meaning: جوزية هو اسم علم مؤنث، مشتق من كلمة جوز، والتي تشير إلى الثبات والقوة. في اللغة العربية، الجوز يرمز إلى الصبر والتحمل. هذا الاسم يعكس صفات الشخصية القوية والثابتة التي تتحمل التحديات والصعوبات. وقد وردت كلمة جوز في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن الجنة والنعيم، مما يعطي الاسم قيمة روحية ودينية.

in_urdu.name: جوزیہ
in_urdu.meaning: مشتق از جوز، مطلب ہے مضبوط اور مستحکم شخصیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: جوزیہ ایک علم مؤنث ہے، جو جوز سے مشتق ہے، جو مضبوطی اور ثبات کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ اردو میں، جوز کا مطلب صبر اور تحمل ہے۔ یہ نام ان شخصیات کی عکاسی کرتا ہے جو مضبوط، مستحکم اور چیلنجوں کا سامنا کرنے میں اہل ہیں۔ جوز کی اصطلاح اسلامی تقویم میں جنت اور نعمت کے حوالے سے ذکر کی گئی ہے، جو اس نام کو روحانی اور دینی اہمیت دیتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जौज़ियह
in_hindi.meaning: जौज़ से उत्पन्न, अर्थ है मजबूत और स्थिर व्यक्तित्व
in_hindi.long_meaning: जौज़ियह एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है, जो जौज़ से व्युत्पन्न है, जो शक्ति और स्थिरता को दर्शाता है। हिंदी में, जौज़ का अर्थ धैर्य और सहनशीलता है। यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों की विशेषता को प्रतिबिंबित करता है जो मजबूत, स्थिर और चुनौतियों का सामना करने में सक्षम हैं। जौज़ की शब्दावली इस्लामी परंपरा में जन्नत और आनंद के संदर्भ में उल्लिखित है, जो इस नाम को आध्यात्मिक और धार्मिक महत्व देती है।

in_pashto.name: جوړې
in_pashto.meaning: د جوړې څخه مشتق شوی، معنی یې پیاوړی او ټینګ شخصیت
in_pashto.long_meaning: جوړې یو ښځینه نوم دی، چی د جوړې څخه مشتق شوی دی، کوم چی پیاوړتی او ټینګښت نښه کوي. په پښتو کی، جوړې د صبر او زغم معنی لري. دا نوم د هغو کسانو ځانګړتیاوې منعکس کوي چی پیاوړي، ټینګ او د ننګونو سره د مقابلې وړتیا لري. جوړې اصطلاح په اسلامي دود کی د جنت او نعمت په حواله ذکر شوې ده، کوم چی دا نوم ته روحاني او دينی ارزښت ورکوي.

in_english.name: Jawziyyah
in_english.meaning: Derived from 'jawz', meaning strong and steadfast personality
in_english.long_meaning: Jawziyyah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic word 'jawz', meaning walnut or strong and steadfast. In Arabic, 'jawz' symbolizes patience, endurance, and resilience. This name reflects the qualities of a strong, stable, and challenging personality. In Islamic tradition, 'jawz' is mentioned in the context of Paradise and bliss, giving the name spiritual and religious significance. The name Jawziyyah is associated with positive attributes such as determination, courage, and perseverance.

data.cultural_impact: Jawziyyah is a name of Arabic origin and holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic world. It signifies the blossoming of youth, representing the beauty, innocence, and purity of childhood. In many Muslim communities, the name is used as a term of endearment for young children, reflecting the charm and beauty associated with the name.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Jawziyyah holds deeper meanings that resonate with the Islamic faith. In Sufism, the mystical branch of Islam, the name Jawziyyah represents the inner beauty and divine illumination of the soul. It is believed that by embodying the virtues associated with the name, one can draw closer to God and attain spiritual growth. Furthermore, Jawziyyah is one of the names of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), reminding Muslims of his beauty, purity, and closeness to God. Thus, Jawziyyah represents both an earthly and a heavenly ideal, inspiring those who bear the name to strive for both spiritual and worldly perfection.
